text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo, word going around is that today's<n>your
birthday. Izzat true?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a huge honor to know that<n>you are aware
of the day of my birth!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast! I didn't even say happy<n>birthday yet!
What're ya jumpin' the<n>gun for?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, I got some tea brewin'. Get<n>your stuff 'n'
follow me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wha—tea?! You made tea just forme?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's nothin' I wouldn't do for my<n>junior! I
made somethin' ridiculously<n>tasty too, so I hope
you're hungry.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I stewed it with lots of carrot, so it's<n>nice and
sweet. Even the fox god<n>would love it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! Eat up as much as ya<n>want! This is
my specially made,<n>ultimate inari sush—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! You made cake?! I'm so<n>happy—a cake
handmade by Inari!<n>Ahh, incredible!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now hold on just a second!
